newsitem.title: USA: RTW Inc Q2 meets company expectations.
newsitem.headline: RTW Inc Q2 meets company expectations.

text.p: RTW Inc, which provides workers' compensation management services, said Monday its second quarter earnings, which were below a year ago, were in line with its expectations.
Earlier, RTW reported earnings of $0.12 a share, down from $0.20 a year ago. In the first half, it earned $0.23 a share, down from $0.39.

"Net income of $0.12 was in line with our expectations for the quarter," David Prosser, chairman, said in a statement. "The lower earnings in the second quarter and first half of 1997 were due to competitive premium pricing and continued investment of our aggressive expansion into new markets."
Revenues were $21.3 million in the second quarter, up from $16.7 million. For the first half, revenues were $42.0 milion, up from $31.8 million.
